scenarios.causalMutation: Replace the Unity Alpha architecture or scene route.

diagnostics.message: Only a narrow family-mode diagnostic marker extension is allowed.

scenarios.causalMutation: Duplicate a family mode id in the family manifest.

diagnostics.message: Family mode ids must be unique.

scenarios.causalMutation: Add a family mode outside Goal 043/047/056 families.

diagnostics.message: Family id must resolve to selected source families.

scenarios.causalMutation: Copy a previous player log without Goal 057 family markers.

diagnostics.message: Player log must be freshly produced by the Goal 057 Unity route.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim Lua execution during Unity family proof.

diagnostics.message: Lua execution is forbidden for Goal 057.

scenarios.causalMutation: Point a media binding to malformed PNG, WAV or bundle bytes.

diagnostics.message: PNG, WAV and bundle refs must remain valid Goal 056 media refs.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove the staged family-loop command plan.

diagnostics.message: Unity player proof requires the staged family command plan.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove Goal 056 media-bound Unity proof artifacts.

diagnostics.message: Goal 056 accepted media-bound source evidence is required.
Goal 057 requires the Goal 056 media manifest in StreamingAssets.

scenarios.causalMutation: Omit a required family_loop_completed marker from the player log.

diagnostics.message: Unity player logs must contain every required family marker.

scenarios.causalMutation: Publish a review package manifest without Goal 056/057 trace refs.

diagnostics.message: Every family proof requires source and review trace refs.

scenarios.causalMutation: Shuffle source, family or command records.

diagnostics.message: Goal 057 records must be deterministically ordered.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim provider, network, LLM or RAG execution.

diagnostics.message: Provider, network, LLM and RAG calls are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim Runtime or public GamePackage schema mutation.

diagnostics.message: Runtime and public GamePackage schema mutation are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Change a staged media file after the manifest hash is recorded.

diagnostics.message: Staged media bytes must match the Goal 056 manifest hash.

scenarios.causalMutation: Use an absolute path or path traversal in staging.

diagnostics.message: Staging paths must be safe relative paths.
